queen_campaign_reads.Queen Sheet Cooling: Ranking, fixed: 15% top-of-search share, 1 click in 4 days. Low volume.

overlap.served_by: Cooling Sheet Queen single (12 clk, 0 ord) · Queen Tail 18 via 'cool sheet queen' (4 clk, 0 ord)
overlap.finding: Queen's biggest keyword has two paths. The single campaign only reaches top of search 0.21% of the time; the tail catches a quarter of the clicks at its own bid.
overlap.proposal: Move the single campaign to Ranking, fixed bid, Top-of-Search +75% (plan). In the same change, add 'cooling sheets queen' as negative exact in Queen Tail 18 so the ranking campaign owns it.
overlap.protects: The tail keeps its own query 'cool sheet queen' (6 clicks). Nothing relevant is blocked: the same shoppers still see our ad through the ranking campaign.

overlap.served_by: Cooling Queen Sheet single, Ranking (1 clk) · Queen Tail 22 via 'cool queen sheet' (1 clk)
overlap.finding: Same close-variant overlap, 2 clicks in 4 days.
overlap.proposal: Negative exact 'cooling queen sheets' in Queen Tail 22, in the same change as above.
overlap.protects: Two clicks of evidence, so it routes traffic and removes nothing; the tail keeps 'cool queen sheet'.

overlap.served_by: Cooling Sheet King Size single, Conversion (22 clk, 2 ord, $56) · King Tail 13 via 'cool sheet king size' (12 clk, 4 ord, $33)
overlap.finding: King's best keyword also has two paths, and the tail is the better converter (4 orders on 12 clicks, 8.7% ACoS).
overlap.proposal: No negative. Leave both paths; review on 27 Oct with King.
overlap.protects: Blocking the tail would remove the path that sells best today. A sale counts toward rank whichever campaign wins the click.

overlap.served_by: Cooling Bed Sheet single (9 clk, 1 ord) · No Size Tail 03 via 'cool bed sheet' (1 clk)
overlap.finding: One click leaked to the tail.

overlap.served_by: Pillowcase-page product targeting (5 clk) · CLPC pillowcase brand exact (2 clk)
overlap.finding: People searching our brand see pillowcase ads; no cooling-sheet branded campaign exists.
overlap.proposal: Launch the planned cooling-sheet branded exact on Queen Graphite ($10/day). Add 'coolinens' as negative exact in the pillowcase-page product-targeting campaign.
overlap.protects: Brand searches are ours by definition; no discovery is lost, and the sheet ad replaces the pillowcase ad.

overlap.item: Rival-page ads showing on unrelated searches
overlap.served_by: Cooling Rivals Queen / King / Twin (product targeting)
overlap.finding: Rival-page campaigns also served on search pages: silk bed sheets (3 clk), tencel lyocell sheets, cooling comforter set, cooling blanket(s), below zero cooling comforter, slumber cloud ultracool comforter, apartment essentials men, sleep number bed sheets.
overlap.proposal: Negative exact on those terms in the rival campaigns. Keep 'nylon spandex sheets' (our fabric), 'cooling sheets' and the rival brand searches.
overlap.protects: Relevance, not performance: none of these is a cooling sheet set. Relevant terms stay open.

overlap.finding: Our own sister brand's search: we would pay to take a sale from ourselves.
overlap.proposal: Negative phrase 'sleephoria' in the rival-page and Auto campaigns.
overlap.protects: Sister brand, so this only stops self-competition.

overlap.finding: Auto served 'bed cooling system', 'electronic cooling for menopause', 'under sheets bed fan' (devices, not sheets) and 'cool linens for hot sleepers' (relevant).
overlap.proposal: Negative exact on the three device searches only. No ranking keywords as negatives in Auto yet: Auto has not bought a single ranking keyword.
overlap.protects: Auto stays open for discovery; a ranking-keyword wall is added only if Auto starts buying ranking keywords.

overlap.item: Sponsored Brands / Video keywords that match ranking keywords
overlap.served_by: SB Queen/King Shades, SBV Rival Video Queen/King/No size, SBV Broad
overlap.finding: Brand and video ads bid on some of the same words, but they show in different slots (banner and video), not in the Sponsored Products auction. They add shelf space; they do not take clicks from the ranking ads.
overlap.proposal: No negatives. Review SBV Broad and the Queen rival video at 30 clicks or on 26 Oct (new video).
overlap.protects: Keeps the extra shelf space and the 7 orders these ads have brought.

decisions.decision: Move 'cooling sheets queen' to Ranking objective, fixed bid $2.24, Top-of-Search +75% (the plan's setting).
decisions.evidence: Queen's biggest keyword (5.7 of Queen's 13.5 planned clicks a day). Now Conversion with down-only bids: top-of-search share 0.21%, 28% of budget used, organic #68.
decisions.gate: None: it restores the plan's setting.

decisions.decision: Re-point Queen ads from Queen White to Queen Graphite.
decisions.evidence: Graphite: 400 units, #1 Queen colour for both sister brands; the Batch 2 gate is measured on Queen Graphite. White: 197 units. This week's colour CVRs (White 1/38, Graphite 3/28) are too small to decide on alone.
decisions.gate: None: plan SKU; check cover the same day.

decisions.decision: Add negative exact for 'cooling sheets queen' in Queen Tail 18 and 'cooling queen sheets' in Queen Tail 22.
decisions.evidence: 4 of 16 and 1 of 2 clicks went to the tails through close-variant matching.

decisions.decision: Negatives for unrelated searches: silk, tencel, comforter and blanket, bed-fan and cooling-device searches, apartment essentials, sleep number; 'sleephoria' as negative phrase.
decisions.evidence: About $35 of clicks on searches for other products or our sister brand.

decisions.decision: Launch the cooling-sheet branded exact ('coolinens', Queen Graphite, $10/day); negative exact 'coolinens' in the pillowcase-page product targeting.
decisions.evidence: Brand searches now show pillowcase ads (7 clicks).

decisions.decision: No change to King: no bid, budget or targeting changes.
decisions.evidence: King SP: 13 orders, ACoS 40% over 4 days, but 9 of the 13 orders came on 18 Oct; without that day ACoS is 87%. King units: 4, 10, 19, 4 vs a 4.3 baseline.
decisions.gate: 7 full days: King SP ACoS ≤ 43.7% with orders on at least 4 of 7 days. Then decide with Zarlish whether King is assigned to CooLinens (push) or capped.

decisions.decision: Keep rival-page campaigns running (only the relevance negatives in D04).
decisions.evidence: 29 clicks, 0 orders: a 17% chance at 6% CVR, so not proof of failure. Decolure's history on rival pages: 42% ACoS.
decisions.gate: 50 clicks per campaign or 30 Oct. Exit a target at 0 orders on 50 clicks (under 2% chance at 8% CVR).

decisions.decision: Keep Auto at its low bid; no ranking-keyword negatives yet.
decisions.evidence: $3.10, 4 clicks. Sleephoria's Auto ran at 6.3% ACoS. Auto has not bought any ranking keyword.
decisions.gate: Add a ranking-keyword wall only if Auto carries more than 40% of any ranking keyword's clicks.

decisions.decision: Hold bids and modifiers; apply the plan's weekly rules on 27 Oct.
decisions.evidence: Spend runs about $257/day vs the plan's $138; ranking-keyword Top-of-Search modifiers +65% to +302%. Four days are too few for the plan's REDUCE rule.
decisions.gate: Plan rule: step the modifier down 25 points where ACoS is above the ranking ceiling for 2 weeks, or CVR is under 60% of plan on 50+ clicks.

decisions.decision: Queen conversion check after D01–D02 have run for 7 days.
decisions.evidence: Queen SP: 1 order on 50 clicks (a 6% chance at plan CVR), on the White listing at $87.99 vs the plan's $79.99.
decisions.gate: If Queen CVR is still under 5.3% (60% of plan) on 50+ clicks after the changes: review price and listing before adding spend.

decisions.decision: Keep SBV running; judge the Queen rival video at 30 clicks; re-plan the SBV test around the new video (studio 26 Oct).
decisions.evidence: SBV King rival video 3 orders at 18% ACoS; Queen rival video 15 clicks, 0 orders (29% chance).
decisions.gate: 30 clicks on the Queen video, or 26 Oct.

decisions.decision: Superseded: the earlier proposals to pause product targeting, Auto and SBV Broad and to cut modifiers now.

decisions.gate: Replaced by D07, D08, D09, D11.

log.headline: Day 5: ads add about 7 units a day, almost all in King. Queen, the priority size, has not moved yet; fix its setup before judging its results.
results: 16–19 Oct: 69 units vs a 39-unit baseline (9.7/day × 4) → about 30 extra units, matching the 29 ad orders. Ads look incremental, not replacing organic sales.
Ad spend $1,158 · 29 ad orders · ACoS 46% (break-even 43.7%) · CVR 8.2% (plan 8.6%) · TACoS 13%.
Queen 14 units after ads vs 9 in the 3 days before (3.5/day vs 3.0/day). King 37 vs 13 (9.3/day vs 4.3/day).
Stock carries a Queen push: Queen Graphite 400 units ≈ 250 days at the plan's 1.2 ad orders/day plus current sales; all Queen colours 1,810 units.
observations: Queen's main keyword 'cooling sheets queen' (organic #68) sits on Conversion with down-only bids and reaches top of search 0.21% of the time. The plan had it as a Ranking push. That, not budget, is why Queen gets so little top-of-search traffic.

Queen rank: 'cooling sheets queen' #76 on 15 Oct → #68 on 20 Oct (target #15). Smaller Queen phrases reached page 1 on most of the last three days ('cooling sheet set queen', 'queen size cooling sheets', 'queen sheet set cooling'). Single-day #3 readings that do not repeat are crawl noise.
Queen converts 1 order on 50 Sponsored Products clicks. That happens 6% of the time at plan CVR, so it is a warning, not yet proof; ads point to the White listing at $87.99 vs the plan's $79.99.
King's result depends on one day (18 Oct). Without it, King ACoS is 87%.
Rival-page ads: 29 clicks, 0 orders, a 17% chance at 6% CVR. Too early to judge, but they also show on unrelated searches (silk, tencel, comforters).
Overlap is small: 6 of 89 search terms were bought by two of our campaigns; Sponsored Brands/Video do not compete in the Sponsored Products auction.
actions: Act now (setup and relevance only): D01 Queen head term to Ranking/fixed/+75%; D02 Queen ads to Graphite; D03 tail negatives for the two Queen head terms; D04 unrelated-search negatives; D05 cooling-sheet branded campaign.

Wait for evidence: D06 King (27 Oct), D07 rival-page ads (50 clicks or 30 Oct), D08 Auto (watch), D09 spend and modifiers (27 Oct, plan weekly rules), D10 Queen conversion (7 days after D01–D02), D11 SBV (26 Oct).
This week: D12 Full and Cal King ad SKUs.
reasoning: Setup fixes restore the live plan and do not depend on four days of noisy data.
Pauses and cuts wait for click counts at which 0 orders or high ACoS is unlikely to be chance.
Queen gets the first fix because it is the priority size and its problem is structural (objective, bid type, ad colour), not budget.
King is left alone until a full week confirms it.
